holder-quote: Too many to dodge. Not for a big lad. The two looked down in shock. At—the torn fabric. The sword literally running through Wilovan’s side—across his fur. His poor coat.
effect-quote: Too many to dodge. Not for a big lad. The two looked down in shock. At—the torn fabric. The sword literally running through Wilovan’s side—across his fur. His poor coat.

holder-quote: Wilovan smiled. Ratici watched him standing there, only wearing his undergarments. The Drake [Thief] coughed.
Wilovan felt blood drying on his fur.
